title: 5 Mandaue City minors 'rescued' after hitting PWD worker with stones

blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Five minors were rescued by the Mandaue City Mayor’s Office following complaints that they threw stones and bottles at a restaurant in Barangay Alang-Alang, injuring a person with disabilities (PWD). The Safety Maintenance Area Response Team (SMART) conducted the operation on Wednesday night, October 14, in coordination with the Philippine National Police (PNP) and the City Social Welfare Services (CSWS). The staff of a restaurant along D.M. Cortes St. had sought assistance over the incident.
